reviews.title: WORKS ON 50 Series cards, as long as your PSU supports it
reviews.comment: SAVED ME!  I bought an Asus PRIME RTX 5070 Ti OC Edition, and it came with a triple pigtail adapter.  My PSU only had 2 plugs power cables, and the card wood not work with only 2 connected to the pigtails (with one empty).  This cable worked like a charm!  AWESOME!
reviews.author: Michael Agcaoili

reviews.title: It's much better and safer than not having it
reviews.comment: The fact that this cable adapter, while cheap, literally removed so much tension and torque off the plug, is reason enough to get this...Nvidia screwed up these cards so bad with this plug type, any relief and ease of stress to the plug is a massive benefit and preventative measure of causing accidents....but because it's the problem with the connector, it's something I can't just willingly forget about, even if this adapter was made with the quality assurance of god in heaven...I sit vigil next to my PC, with my eye on the plug at all times, checking it occasionally, because I cannot risk anything going up in flames...
reviews.author: Nathan B.
